title: Exactness of the DNN Relaxation for Random Standard Quadratic Programs
summary: We study the doubly nonnegative (DNN) relaxation of the standard quadratic optimization problem \[ \min\{x^\top Qx:\ x\inΔ^{n-1}\},\qquad Δ^{n-1}:=\{x\in\mathbb{R}_+^n:\ \mathbb{1}^\top x=1\}, \] for random symmetric matrices with independent diagonal and off-diagonal entries. Let $m_n:=\min_{1\le i\le n} Q_{ii}$ and set $M:=Q-m_nE$, where $E$ is the all-ones matrix. The negative off-diagonal entries of $M$ define a defect graph $G_n^-$.
